about.compare: This is a catalog of publicly available pages.
about.did: It has levels, series, episode numbers, outbound links, local checkmarks, and interface language.
about.not: Stories, audio, exercises, and printable books stay on the third-party official site. Logging in with your 学园 nickname saves progress and syncs it across devices. Quiz, Words, Game, and Print need a sign-in on the third-party official site.
about.page: An episode has no address of its own. Open goes to the series page stored in the table. That address is copied, not recalculated.
about.parts: Quiz, Words, Game, and Print are links at the bottom of a card and need a sign-in on the third-party official site. Text and Audio are not listed separately.
about.thumb: Thumbnails stay at their original address. If one fails, a drawn book placeholder is shown. The image is not saved here.
